name: Josheni
source:
Spent his youth in a quiet country house, where he developed a love for the outdoors. Regularly joins teachers' academic trips. Famous for his easy-going personality and a list of adventures that would make book characters jealous. Favourite line: [i]"Nothing bad will ever happen to me!"[/i]

[Edited from the in-game description]
